faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the AI Video Factory

quality.question: Is the AI-generated content high quality?
quality.answer: Yes! We use state-of-the-art AI models (OpenRouter LLMs, ElevenLabs voice synthesis, D-ID avatars) to create professional-grade videos. You maintain full creative control with script editing, voice customization, and final approval before publishing.

copyright.question: What about copyright and content ownership?
copyright.answer: All AI-generated content created through our platform is yours to own. We use licensed AI tools that grant commercial usage rights. You retain 100% ownership of your videos, channel, and revenue.

time.question: How long does it take to create a video?
time.answer: With our templates and automation, most videos can be created in under 40 minutes: 5 mins for script generation, 10 mins for AI video creation, 3 mins for voice-over, 15 mins for editing, and 5 mins for upload. After training, many creators reduce this to 20-30 minutes per video.

skills.question: Do I need technical skills or video editing experience?
skills.answer: No! Our platform is designed for beginners. We provide step-by-step tutorials, pre-made templates, and AI automation that handles the complex parts. If you can use YouTube and fill out forms, you can use our system.

support.question: What kind of support do you offer?
support.answer: Starter tier includes email support. Growth tier adds chat support with faster response times. Premium tier includes priority 24/7 support with dedicated account management and monthly strategy calls.

money.question: Can I really make money with affiliate marketing?
money.answer: Yes, but success depends on your niche, content quality, and consistency. Our auto-affiliate engine connects you with 20+ high-paying programs (SmartSuite at 50%, Shopify at 200%, etc.). Many creators earn $500-$5,000/month in commissions after building an audience.

tiers.question: What's the difference between the pricing tiers?
tiers.answer: Starter ($199/mo) gives you 5 templates, auto-discovery engine, analytics, and email support. Growth ($399/mo) unlocks unlimited templates, advanced analytics, ROI calculator, and priority support. Premium ($799/mo) adds custom templates, unlimited channels, direct founder access, and API integrations. Master ($4,999 one-time) includes everything forever with 1-on-1 onboarding and VIP support.

refund.question: Is there a refund policy?
refund.answer: Yes! We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with the platform, contact us within 30 days of purchase for a full refund, no questions asked.

telegram.heroIntro: Control Sophia from your phone 24/7 via the <mono>@Sophia_Bbot</mono> Telegram bot.

step1.title: Install Telegram
step1.description: Download the Telegram app from the App Store (iPhone) or Google Play (Android). Sign up with your phone number if you don't have an account.

step2.title: Find the Sophia Bot
step2.description: Open Telegram, tap the magnifying glass, and search for @Sophia_Bbot (note the capital B). Tap the result and press START.

step3.title: Link Your Account
step3.description: Type the <mono>/email</mono> command followed by the email you used to sign up for Sophia. The bot will send a 6-digit code to your email — enter it in Telegram.

step4.title: Create Your First Video
step4.description: Type <mono>/campaign</mono> followed by your video topic. The bot processes it in 2–5 minutes and notifies you when done. Type <mono>/results</mono> to get the link.

privacy.meta_description: How Sophia AI Factory collects, uses, and protects your data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1_body: We collect information you provide directly: email address, name, API keys (encrypted at rest), and payment transaction records. We do NOT sell your data.
privacy.section2_body: Your data is used solely to provide and improve the Service — generating AI videos, processing payments, and sending transactional emails. API keys are encrypted using AES-256-GCM.
privacy.section3_body: Data is stored on Cloudflare D1 (global edge database) and Cloudflare R2 (object storage). All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest. We implement CSP, HSTS, and CSRF protection.
privacy.section4_body: We use third-party services to deliver the Service: HeyGen (video generation), ElevenLabs (text-to-speech), OpenRouter (AI script writing), NOWPayments (payment processing), and Resend (email delivery). Each service has its own privacy policy.
privacy.section5_body: You may request deletion of your data at any time. Contact us to exercise your data rights. We will respond within 30 days.
privacy.section6_body: Data protection inquiries: Telegram @Sophia_Bbot or email support.

terms.meta_title: Terms of Service - Sophia AI Factory
terms.meta_description: Terms and conditions for using Sophia AI Factory — AI Video SaaS Platform.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1_body: By accessing or using Sophia AI Factory ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.
terms.section2_body: The Service is offered on a subscription basis. Plans are billed monthly in USDT via NOWPayments. You are responsible for maintaining accurate payment information. Failed payments may result in service suspension.
